items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Debussy is my lyricism man, and Rachmaninoff is my Oscar Peterson man.

ctx.x: You also cited Debussy and Rachmaninoff as two of your early influences.

That‘s right. Debussy is my lyricism man, and Rachmaninoff is my Oscar Peterson man. I was in San Francisco and I just got it. I was really thrilled, you know. He wants that I be a part of his tribute.
